text:
Nina L: Heads up 9  we need a minimal partner SEV flow that works across marketplace, hw and SI integrations. current chaos: multiple private threads, unsure first-ack owner.
Diego M: Agreed. proposal: single shared channel + optional private warroom. Keep the shared channel as the canonical timeline.
Priya S: Concrete pattern: create #partner-<short>-sev (public shared with partner), then run `/sev start` to spin up a warroom and PD link. ops-bot: could we auto-set the channel topic with owner tags when created?
ops-bot: (bot) yes. prototype will populate: "owner: @partner-l1 | rdw-oncall: @redwood-oncall | pd: <link>" and post warroom link on creation. webhook: https://hooks.redwood.dev/partner-sev-proto
Nina L: Ack windows: partner L1 should ack in 5m for sev-1, RDW oncall in 10m if partner doesn't respond. Document fallback: if partner unreachable after 10m, RDW takes lead and notifies partner.
Diego M: Escalation ladder shortform to paste in channels: 0-10m: partner L1 ack & triage. 10-30m: RDW oncall joins + starts diagnostics. 30-90m: RDW eng L2 + partner eng involved. >90m: exec updates + consider traffic reroute/fallback.
Priya S: Warroom checklist (one-liner items):
- Severity label + impact (customer, region, internal)
- PD link and short summary
- Assigned owners (partner L1, partner L2, RDW L1, RDW L2)
- Short mitigation plan and next action (10m actions)
- Postmortem owner assigned (24h)
- Archive policy: keep shared channel open 7 days then move conversation summary to #partner-archive
Nina L: Templates to paste into shared channel (one-liner):
```
@channel SEV-1 impact=production
Partner=ZephyrCorp
PD=<link>
RDW-owner=@redwood-oncall
Ack-window=10m
Warroom=<link>
```
Diego M: Also add privacy guidance: if PII or regulated customer is involved, call security/legal privately before posting full details in shared channel. note that some partners require sanitized messaging.
Priya S: SLAs: mirror partner contract initial-ack. if contract silent, use default 10m for sev-1 and 20m for sev-2 before RDW takeover. add these numbers to each partner-runbook.
Nina L: Who owns writing the runbook? I can draft a 1-page runbook and include channel name conventions + checklist. Diego can own ops integration for `/sev` and webhooks. Priya will review for contracts and legal hooks.
Diego M: I'll open a ticket (OPS-4321) to track webhook work and pub/sub for warroom creation. ops-bot: please create the template PR in repo partner-runbooks when ready.
ops-bot: (bot) created OPS-4321 and linked prototype webhook. will create PR template on request.
Priya S: One more: use channel topics for rapid hunt: include short contact list and immediate commands to run (e.g., `curl status`, `kubectl get pods -n partner`). Keep commands as examples, not exhaustive.
Nina L: Great. I'll have a PR with the runbook and channel/topic naming by tomorrow EOD. reviewers: Diego + Priya.
Diego M: :thumbsup: I'll start the webhook ticket and prototype the ops-bot responses.
Priya S: Adding this thread to weekly partnerships sync so we can sign off with legal and partner success.
Nina L: Thanks all. planning note: add a short training doc for partners so they know the expected ack windows and warroom pattern.
